zumi.title: Zumi - Household Expense Tracker
zumi.description: An app to track household expenses: shared budgeting and real-time spending tracking.

caseStudy.problem: Families lose visibility over shared expenses when each person logs purchases separately, with no shared budget and no real-time view of what's left to spend.
caseStudy.solution: I'm building Zumi as a household-budgeting app: fast expense logging, categorization, and a shared view across family members. Built on Next.js with a focus on low load times from day one.
caseStudy.result: Actively in development, approaching its first public deploy. Metrics to publish soon: Lighthouse score, initial load time, and data architecture.

moki.title: Moki - Your Pantry, Zero Waste
moki.description: A pantry management app that reduces food waste and generates AI-powered recipes from what you already have at home.

caseStudy.problem: A large share of household food waste happens because people don't know what they have on hand or what to cook with it before it expires.
caseStudy.solution: Moki tracks your pantry inventory and uses a generative AI model to suggest concrete recipes using ingredients you already have, prioritizing what's closest to expiring. Google login reduces signup friction.
caseStudy.result: Actively in development. Metrics to publish soon: recipe recommendation accuracy and model response time.

fince.title: FINCE: AI-Powered Finance Manager
fince.description: An intelligent finance management platform that uses AI to analyze spending patterns and generate personalized budget recommendations.

caseStudy.problem: Users without formal financial education struggle to identify spending patterns or get actionable recommendations for their monthly budget.
caseStudy.solution: I integrated the Groq AI API to process transactions and generate personalized budget recommendations, with PostgreSQL as the persistence layer and a React dashboard to visualize spending patterns in real time.
caseStudy.result: A functional, deployed personal project. The stack is built to scale, with a clear separation between frontend, business logic, and the AI layer.

pizza.title: Happy Pizza - Website
pizza.description: A restaurant website with a modern design, interactive menu, and WhatsApp-integrated ordering system.

caseStudy.problem: Small restaurants lose orders when their only sales channel is the phone: high friction, no visual menu, and no 24/7 availability.
caseStudy.solution: I designed a site with an interactive menu and a simplified checkout that sends the completed order straight to WhatsApp, removing the need to dictate an order over the phone.
caseStudy.result: Live in production, fully responsive, built with a focus on load speed and menu clarity to reduce drop-off before completing an order.
